schema:
CREATE TABLE tasks (task_id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, priority TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE submissions (sub_id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, task_id INTEGER NOT NULL, completed_at TEXT DEFAULT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES tasks (task_id));
correct_query: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(NOT s.completed_at IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(s.task_id) FROM submissions AS s INNER JOIN tasks AS t ON s.task_id = t.task_id WHERE t.priority = 'high'

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Mutant divides by COUNT(*) before multiplying by 100 on an IS NOT NULL conditional aggregate, altering IEEE-754 floating-point evaluation order on non-dyadic row counts.
